notes: I changed the model from empty to: transform only the last character of each string — letters shift to the next letter (wrapping z→a, Z→A), while digits, spaces, and symbols are unchanged. This fits E2 exactly and most of E1; the `bananaUPPER`→`bananaUPPF` case is an unexplained anomaly I've flagged in comments (possibly a length-changing rule for some uppercase endings).
